dialogs.name: reporting-window
dialogs.text:
Reporting window

1–28 February 2026 · All locations · AED

The comparison and directory use this same exact reporting window. Each channel shows whether its revenue and loss data are available.

This prototype has two fictional monthly reports. These are not live or recently fetched records.

dialogs.name: coverage
dialogs.text:
Data coverage

1–28 February 2026 · All locations · AED

Delivery A
Measured
Delivery B
Measured
Direct
Revenue only
In-store
Needs analysis
Illustrative records for design review. “Measured” means revenue and provider-reported loss are available. It does not establish profit or attribute a result to platform actions.

Revenue-only channels contribute to reported revenue. Channels without analysis remain visible, with no invented values.

dialogs.name: setup-help
dialogs.text:
A channel is where you sell

A marketplace, your website or a physical store can each be a channel. Keep them together here to compare performance and organise reporting.

Channel identity
Name and category
Locations
Where the channel operates
Report labels
Other names for the same channel
Adding a channel does not connect a provider or grant permission to run campaigns. Connections stay in Integration Hub.
